variants.name: ImportZoneFile
variants.summary: The Records tab with Import zone file open: a large `Drawer` that takes one BIND zone file from a `FileDropzone` (or Browse files) or pasted into a `Textarea`, parses it once typing pauses ($ORIGIN, $TTL with units, inherited names, quoted TXT) and previews every line in a `DataTable` paginated at 10 with its line number, name, type, value and a Ready, Skipped or Error `Tag`, the reason under the value. A polite status line counts ready, skipped and errors; errors raise a danger `Alert` saying the ready records still import. The SOA, the apex NS and unsupported types are skipped with their reason; a bad address or a missing value is an error. Import N records adds the ready ones to the table and reports through a toast that counts what was left out.
